answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every entry must show Silvered indexer gear warrant before the ledger opens, because a warrant indexers carry after index trials. For every name, an examination charge of £7, charged again each time a name fails leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. ripple stays on the record. The karst is checked, not assumed. The tally keeps gale.
